$comment: Task-12 workspace-root wiring (project-ide todo 12). The IDE (this Alwork worktree, branch alwork-ide-wave1) opens exactly these four roots. Each root resolves its own agents/context files; cross-root access is denied unless explicitly scoped here. No repos merged, no product code moved.

host.note: IDE host code lives here; it is NOT a workspace folder. Never open or edit I:/migration/Alwork (the sibling checkout) from this workspace.

migration-root.agentsNote: No AGENTS.md at this root (verified 2026-10-08). Authority is the plan plus auth docs.
migration-root.scope: Plans and docs only. Nested checkouts (auth-service, libre-webui, AlRepo, Alwork, oh-my-openAlcore) must be edited through their dedicated roots, never via this root.

auth-service.agentsNote: No AGENTS.md in this repo (verified 2026-10-08). Authority is README.md plus package.json scripts.
auth-service.runtime: Bun only: bun test, bun run --hot src/index.ts, tsc --noEmit
auth-service.scope: Identity-only WHO (users, provider_identities, sessions, oidc_codes, product_exchange_codes). No customers, billing, balances, usage, keys, subscriptions.

libre-webui.runtime: Node.js 22.22+ and npm only. Never pnpm, Yarn, or Bun in this repo.
libre-webui.scope: Self-hosted local-first AI workspace (frontend React 19 + backend Express 5). TokenPanel skills and TokenPanel DB schemas must never load here.

AlRepo.runtime: Bun only with turbo workspaces (bun install, bun run dev/build/typecheck, bun test)
AlRepo.scope: TokenPanel usage tracking and access control. Auth-service identity tables must never be edited here; link by customer.authUserId only.

crossRoot.nestedRule: Paths under I:/migration/auth-service, I:/migration/libre-webui, or I:/migration/AlRepo reached through migration-root resolve to their dedicated root instead.
crossRoot.unknownRoot: Any root name not in allowedRoots is rejected with OMO_WORKSPACE_UNKNOWN_ROOT; nothing resolves, nothing is created.
crossRoot.outOfScopeExample: I:/migration/oh-my-openAlcore is NOT a workspace root: engine sources stay out of the IDE roots (SUL boundary).
